source_title: SIGKDD KDD Cup 2010 student performance evaluation: Data
verified_semantics: The official format defines unique step identity as the pair Problem Name and Step Name. Those columns remain supplied in prediction/test records; correctness, hints and response-timing fields are withheld.
scope: Supports known target-step metadata in the benchmark. Does not establish chronological deployment validity or equivalence of local student partition to the official challenge split.
implementation_change: None; confirms the already frozen composite identity.
